chain: 账单页面/截图/粘贴文本 → OCR/草稿候选 → 字段级校验与人工复核 → book 导出 → close 独立复算 → 月结报告与例外处置
boundary: synthetic fixture acceptance only: no live external read, no real OCR engine quality claim, no payment; signoff in the close chain still does not authorize payment

entries.user_intent: 把一张粘贴文本的供应商账单核验到月结（字段复核+独立复算+报告）
entries.expected_terminal_state: DELIVERED（候选 booked；close 链完成报告与署名复核）
entries.real_side_effect: 本地文件写入：候选草稿、bills 导出、period-job、canonical、六份报告对象；无网络、无付款
entries.evidence_grade: synthetic（合成夹具，本地全链；不是 live-external）

entries.user_intent: 把一张账单截图（本地 Vision OCR 产出）核验到月结，字段能回到截图区域
entries.input: synthetic png + injected verovo.ocr-lines/1 (no real OCR engine needed)
entries.expected_terminal_state: DELIVERED（同上；关键字段带 bbox 证据）
entries.real_side_effect: 同 paste 路径；截图逐字节保留并作为 unreviewed 文档进入 canonical documents
entries.evidence_grade: synthetic（注入 OCR 结果；真实 Vision 质量未在此验收）

entries.user_intent: 乱码截图不应变成假精确账单
entries.real_side_effect: 草稿保留在候选库，字段全部为空，不产生任何账本行

entries.user_intent: 同一张发票（同 vendor+invoice_no）不得双计
entries.real_side_effect: 第一张已入账的 bills 导出保持唯一；第二次 book 被拒绝

observed_outcome.refusal: REVIEW_REQUIRED: invoice inv-2026-1023 of vendor-1 is already booked as cand-0001; a duplicate invoice never double-books — dispute it through the close report

entries.user_intent: OCR/粘贴草稿不得自动入账（高置信也不行）
entries.real_side_effect: 只产生候选草稿文件；无 bills 导出、无 period-job

terminal.user_action: review the queued fields (bill-candidate review ... --field <name> --value <value> --by <reviewer>), then book explicitly with bill-candidate book --by

entries.user_intent: 要求付费云 OCR 引擎时不得静默失败或代购
entries.real_side_effect: 无网络调用、无采购；只输出 §5 结构化 JSON

receipt.item: a paid cloud OCR engine is required by --engine paid-cloud-ocr and is not procured
receipt.why: the local chain only uses free local inputs: pasted text, a text file, or macOS Vision on a screenshot; Verovo never buys or subscribes on the user's behalf
receipt.user_action: procure the OCR API and provide its output yourself via --ocr-json, or use the free paths: --text/--paste or --image with the local Vision runner
alternatives: precompute the OCR result and pass --ocr-json
narrow the period and type the key fields manually
